official_register.name: Hotels Licensing Board (HLB), administered by the Singapore Tourism Board (STB)
official_register.register: Licensed Hotels — active list, published as open data on data.gov.sg
official_register.note: Serviced apartments with 4 or more rooms operate under the Hotels Act and must hold a Certificate of Registration and Hotel-Keeper's Licence issued by HLB; appearing on the active Licensed Hotels register is the accreditation. All six accepted providers were matched by exact premises NAME in the HLB GeoJSON dataset (468 licensed premises total).

scope: 4-6 serviced-apartment / serviced-suite providers in Singapore for a relocating EP holder's temporary accommodation, each verified against an OFFICIAL register (HLB/STB Licensed Hotels via data.gov.sg). Providers whose only provenance was their own website (tier-3) were rejected. corridor='XX-SG' (temporary accommodation is not corridor-specific). All records candidate-only, awaiting human verification.
provenance_notes: accreditation_body=HLB for every accepted provider. accreditation_number and accreditation_expiry are LEFT BLANK because the public HLB data.gov.sg dataset does not expose individual licence numbers or expiry dates — it lists premises name, hotel-keeper (licensee) name, total rooms, postal code and location. No licence number or expiry was invented. website_url is the operator's own brand domain (informational only; Ascott Orchard, Ascott Raffles Place, Citadines Rochor and lyf Funan are all The Ascott Limited brands at discoverasr.com).
source_access_notes: The data.gov.sg datastore_search JSON endpoint returned no text via the platform scraper (it expects HTML), and the api-open poll-download endpoint likewise returned no text via the scraper. The dataset was retrieved successfully via a direct HTTPS download of the official data.gov.sg S3 blob (poll-download API -> signed S3 URL) and parsed locally. No provider was accepted without an exact match on the official HLB register.
